name: Awesomic
long_description:
Awesomic matches companies with top & vetted product talents in 24 hours. Find your designers, engineers or no-coders in a few clicks. They deliver you results through our app, every 24 business hours guaranteed, for a flat monthly subscription.

Successfully matched 4000+ companies, including 400+ YC startups, with their talents who completed over 14 000 projects in the app.

Book a live demo here: https://www.awesomic.com/demo

Portfolio – https://www.awesomic.com/portfolio
Cases – https://www.awesomic.com/case-study

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Hi, I'm Stacy (short from Anastasia). I'm Ukrainian based in San Francisco, entrepreneur from Forbes 30 under 30 list, with 2 times being on its printed covers.
My background is in marketing, my passion is in creating awesome products (and teams).
At 19, I graduated from 2 universities at once, then worked in marketing for 5 years.
With my co-founder we were matched in Tinder 9 years ago — and now we match talents with the jobs :) Awesomic is our third business. Hope you had fun reading this!

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Roman is a self-taught hacker, builder, and hustler from Ukraine. At 13 y.o., he started launching various projects, including startups and game servers. He dropped out of college to pursue his passion. In 2020, Roman founded Awesomic (S21), which was recognized as the Fastest Growing Startup in Ukraine 2021 and named in Forbes 30u30.

launches.title: New Awesomic: Prompt with AI, perfect with experts — all in one app
launches.tagline: Your AI, tools, and humans. Better together.
launches.body:
> _Your AI, tools, and humans. Better together._

Product Demo made in Awesomic app: 

\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZuDp9OvYYDM> 

Hey everyone 👋

We're Stacy and Roman, founders of Awesomic. So far, 4,000+ companies (500+ YC) have used [**Awesomic**](http://awesomic.com/?ref=bookface) and finished 30,000+ tasks with our vetted experts.

**TL;DR: Supernova is our biggest Awesomic release yet. Your AI agents, your team and vetted experts work on the same projects in one app, on desktop and phone. Every project runs on its own cloud computer with 32 GB of RAM and 1 TB of storage, so a project can be a website, a CRM, a dev environment or any always-on agent, not just a chat. When the work needs a pro's eye, a vetted expert joins the same project: usually a designer, since that's where Awesomic started, or a developer or marketer when the task calls for one.**

### **🤔 The problem**

Agents now do most of the work. But the last 20% (taste, brand, judgment) is the new 80%, and getting there is harder than it should be:

* \- **Laptops can't run agents for long.** The battery dies, the machine overheats, and the work stops when you close the lid. And it's single-player, so nobody else can see it or jump in.
* \- **Work is scattered.** AI, apps and files live in a dozen places, and you re-explain context all day.
* \- **Hiring people is slow.** It takes weeks, then onboarding before any real work starts. If the person doesn't work out, that money is gone.
* \- **Nobody sees what works.** Everyone uses AI in their own chats, and your data sits in someone else's service.

### **🎬 How it clicked for us**

Roman here. I spend most of my day working with agents. For this launch I made the first versions of our landing page and video with agents in Awesomic. When the video needed a pro's eye, I handed the task to one of our designers right from the same project. They opened the same files and chat history, picked it up and finished it the same day. I didn't write a brief or send a single file.

That's how our whole team works now. Pages that used to take weeks go live in hours.

### **✅ What you get**

**Made for design and AI workflows, and more.**

A launch used to mean five tools and three freelancers. In Awesomic it's one project: start from a style you like on Explore, an agent makes the launch video and builds the site in the same look, and a designer polishes the last 20% with the same files and history. Every step lands on one task board, so you always know what's done and who has it.

![From a trend in Explore to a video, a site, an expert task and the team board](https://generated-site-76afa30f.awesomic.app/img/yc/gif/workflows.gif?v=10e90401-90db-4dae-a168-56543fb956d5)

And it's not one kind of work. Landing pages, decks, apps, launch videos, brand kits and email campaigns all run through the same flow: one prompt, an agent that shows its plan, and a real result you can ship or hand to an expert.

![One flow for a landing page, a pitch deck, an app, a video and a brand kit](https://generated-site-76afa30f.awesomic.app/img/yc/gif/tasktypes.gif?v=10e90401-90db-4dae-a168-56543fb956d5)

**Vetted experts who finish the job.**

Some work needs a person you can trust. Your agent drafts the pitch deck, and a designer makes the story and the visuals land. Design is where Awesomic started, and designers are still the core of our network, alongside developers and marketers. Hand a task to a top-1% expert right from the chat. They join your project, see the files, the brand and everything your agents did, and take the task all the way to done. No brief, no onboarding. Experts are matched within 24 hours and rematches are free. Bring one in for a single task, hire long-term, or make them the person in the loop who reviews and finishes what your agents produce.

![Hand a task to a vetted expert who delivers in the same project](https://generated-site-76afa30f.awesomic.app/img/yc/gif/experts.gif?v=10e90401-90db-4dae-a168-56543fb956d5)

**Every project is its own computer.**

It looks like a chat, but behind every project is an ultra-fast VM that boots in 7 seconds, with 32 GB of RAM and 1 TB of storage. The project is a folder of files that agents can install, run and publish from, so it can be a website, an internal CRM, a dev environment or any always-on agent. It handles a two-minute request as well as an agent that runs for hours in the background, and you can schedule tasks to run on their own. Share the project and your whole team works on the same machine.

![Project files, a long background run, scheduled tasks and sharing](https://generated-site-76afa30f.awesomic.app/img/yc/gif/computer.gif?v=10e90401-90db-4dae-a168-56543fb956d5)

**One office for all your work.**

Connect Slack, Notion, Figma, GitHub, HubSpot, your ad accounts and 1,000+ other apps once. Keys and logins go in a shared team keychain: add a key once, and every teammate's agents can use it without anyone seeing the value. Set your brand once, and every agent and teammate works from the same memory. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and the top models are built in. Switch any time, with no lock-in and one unified bill across every AI.

![Apps, a shared keychain and every top model in one composer](https://generated-site-76afa30f.awesomic.app/img/yc/gif/office.gif?v=10e90401-90db-4dae-a168-56543fb956d5)

**Your company's brain, under your control.**

Projects, files, connections and skills are shared across the team, so nobody starts from zero. You can see every prompt and result your team creates without chasing screenshots, and turn what works into shared skills. Access, approved models and budgets are set per person. And because Awesomic is going open source, your company's memory can stay fully private: run it on your own infrastructure, and your files, prompts and keys never leave it.

![Every prompt your team writes, a chat saved as a team skill, and per-person budgets and models](https://generated-site-76afa30f.awesomic.app/img/yc/gif/control.gif?v=10e90401-90db-4dae-a168-56543fb956d5)

**All of it on your phone, on iOS and Android.**

The mobile app isn't just a viewer. Start a task from a prompt, watch the agent work, open the live result, hand it to an expert and check the team board. Kick off a landing page on the train, and it's live before you reach the office.

![Explore, prompt and a new task coming to life on the phone](https://generated-site-76afa30f.awesomic.app/img/yc/gif/mobile.gif?v=10e90401-90db-4dae-a168-56543fb956d5)

Try it 👉 [awesomic.com](http://awesomic.com)
